lines.en: Huh. I guess Chika's busy right now.
lines.zh: 嗯。Chika 现在大概在忙吧。

lines.en: I don't want to call her right now...
lines.zh: 我现在不想叫她……

lines.en: if chap4active == True and senseisad == False:
I tap on Chika's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点下 Chika 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: : Heya! Great timing. I actually just got back to the apartment.
lines.zh: : 嘿！正好。我其实刚回到公寓。

lines.en: : Not staying at the dorm tonight?
lines.zh: : 今晚不住宿舍？

lines.en: : Nahh. Gonna hang out with my sister instead.
lines.zh: : 不啦。我要跟我妹妹待着。

lines.en: : You wanna come over and watch movies or something?
lines.zh: : 你要不要过来一起看个电影什么的？
: 好啊。我马上到。
: 好——的！待会儿见~

lines.en: I drop what I'm doing (Which is essentially nothing) and get on the first bus to the second half of town...
lines.zh: 我放下手上的事（基本上也没什么事），赶上第一班去城市另一半的公交……

lines.en: I arrive to find both Chika and Chinami in their pajamas and huddled under the blanket watching some drama I've never seen before.
lines.zh: 到了之后，Chika 和 Chinami 都穿着睡衣，裹在同一条毯子里看一部我从没看过的剧。

lines.en: I'm glad that the two of them are comfortable enough to let me into the house like this, but I guess they don't really have any reason to {i}not{/i} trust me given that I pay their phone bill.
lines.zh: 我很高兴她们俩自在到能这样让我进屋，不过想想我替她们付手机费，她们也确实没什么理由{i}不{/i}信我。

lines.en: Regardless, Chika lets Chinami watch a few episodes alone so the two of us can hang out on her balcony and talk.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，Chika 让 Chinami 自己先看几集，好让我俩能去她阳台上聊天。

lines.en: I watch as she gazes joyfully up at the stars, her body outlined by the subtle light of the moon.
lines.zh: 她抬头望着星星，笑得很开心，月光淡淡地勾出她的轮廓。

lines.en: And even if the moment comes and goes the second a cloud gets in the way, it's a sight I'll find hard to forget.
lines.zh: 就算这画面在云飘过来的那一瞬间就没了，它也是我很难忘掉的景象。

lines.en: Chinami is already asleep by the time the two of us go back inside, so I decide to go home a little ahead of schedule.
lines.zh: 我俩回屋时 Chinami 已经睡着了，于是我决定比原计划早一点回家。

lines.en: Chika apologizes for making me come all the way here to just hang out on her balcony, but I don't mind.
lines.zh: Chika 为让我大老远跑来只为在阳台上待一会儿而道歉，但我并不介意。

lines.en: She hugs me tightly just as I'm about to leave, and the two of us reluctantly break apart and go back to our respective lives...
lines.zh: 我正要走的时候她紧紧抱住我，最后我俩不情愿地分开，各自回到各自的生活……
$ chika_love += 1
{i}Chika 的好感度提升到了 [chika_love]!{/i}
